unit.title: A Cultural Story: The Farmer and His Sons

contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ। ਅੱਜ ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਲਿਖੋ! (You've learned the story and its lesson. Today, write about it!)

Using last week's paragraph-writing skills, write a short paragraph retelling this week's story in your own words: start with who the ਕਿਸਾਨ (farmer) and his ਪੁੱਤਰ (sons) were, what happened in the ਖੇਤ (field), and end with the real lesson about ਮਿਹਨਤ (hard work). Use at least 3 of this week's 5 new vocabulary words in your paragraph.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੈਰਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ! (You just wrote a complete paragraph!) Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Write a short paragraph retelling this week's cultural story
Use at least 3 of this week's 5 vocabulary words correctly in the paragraph
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's story, lesson, and vocabulary.
2. Remind the child of last week's paragraph structure (topic/details/closing).
3. Have the child write their retelling paragraph, checking for at least 3 vocabulary words.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: provide a simple sentence-starter outline (Who → What happened → Lesson) to scaffold the paragraph
Ready for more: ask the child to also include their own personal example from yesterday's lesson in the paragraph
This lesson directly connects last week's paragraph-writing skill and this week's vocabulary/story content — the exact synthesis the course description points toward
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended writing activity — check that the child's paragraph correctly retells the story's key events, states the hard-work lesson, and uses at least 3 of this week's 5 vocabulary words.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses all three of the course's threads together (paragraph writing, vocabulary, cultural stories), synthesizing them into one real piece of writing.

generationData.instructions: Write a paragraph retelling this week's story, using at least 3 of this week's vocabulary words.
